hero.title: Broken Denture? Get It Fixed in Under 90 Minutes
hero.description: Technical dental laboratory — broken denture repaired today, guaranteed. Eat, smile, and enjoy your day without worry.

b1.title: Fast Repairs
b1.desc: Get your denture fixed today in under 90 minutes for holidays, business meetings, or nights out.

b2.title: Guaranteed Fit
b2.desc: We guarantee your denture will fit perfectly — quality repairs.

b3.title: Certified Experts
b3.desc: Since 2004, our laboratory has repaired all types of dentures — from simple to complex cases.

process.title: How it works
process.subtitle: Your denture repaired in 3 simple steps

step1.title: Call Us First
step1.desc: Tell us what happened or send a photo for a quick assessment, and we’ll schedule your appointment.

step2.title: Bring Your Denture In
step2.desc: Drop it off at our certified lab, where our experts quickly assess and start repairing it with precision.

step3.title: Pick Up Same Day
step3.desc: Collect your fully repaired denture in under 90 minutes—fast, precise, and guaranteed to fit.

q1.question: How fast can my denture be repaired?
q1.answer: Most repairs are done the same day, often under 90 minutes from the moment you bring them in.

q2.question: Do I need an appointment?
q2.answer: Yes. While we are open 24/7, please call first before coming.

q3.question: How much does a denture repair cost?
q3.answer: Please call us for a personalized quote — we’ll provide exact pricing and confirm same-day service availability.

q4.question: Do you also work on holidays?
q4.answer: Holiday repairs are possible, but availability is limited. Please call us first to confirm and reserve your spot.

q5.question: I called and got no reply — are you really open 24/7?
q5.answer: We’re open 24/7, but sometimes we’re very busy. Please leave a message or try again, and we’ll call you back ASAP.

cta.title: Still have questions?
cta.description: If you need more details, want to arrange an appointment, or are ready to drop off your denture, just give us a call — we’re available 24/7.
